l3_exempt.hsmfaultneg: the tasklet fault scenario ends on the second guest's breakpoint, so it runs on the extended profile only

caps_absent.boot_console: the H5 wolfBoot first stage prints no console lines the runner asserts
caps_absent.prot_trace: the M33MU STM32H5 model has no protection-unit trace; a GTZC refusal is proven by the guest's own read-back
caps_absent.guest_fence: the H5 guest write protection is the option-byte WRP that provisioning sets, not a first-stage fence
caps_absent.handler_overrun: the Non-secure handler overrun scenario exists only for the bare-metal guest ports
caps_absent.busfault: M33MU at the pinned ref does not vector a precise data BusFault (busfaultneg lands with the pin bump)

faults_by_design.fpneg: M33MU ends the run itself when the relay's FP instruction raises NOCP
faults_by_design.mspovfneg: M33MU escalates the entry-time STKOF to HardFault and ends the run there
faults_by_design.xnneg: M33MU pends the gate's denied fetch from SPM RAM past the active SVC instead of escalating it

exempt.wrpoff: the emulator has no WRP model; wrpoff runs on the Nucleo through the hardware runner

caps_absent.rom_xip: the Nucleo boots through wolfBoot in internal flash; there is no XIP ROM smoke image
caps_absent.ns_handler_probes: the NS entry-mask and parked-IRQ probes live in the bare-metal guest the Nucleo runs only for psa

hardware.fixture: TZEN set, product state Open, WRPSGn1 clear on the guest windows; provisioning_ctrl.sh restore puts a board back
